comment: One user task per acceptance journey J01 to J10 (acceptance-manifest.json). The task text is what a first-time reader would want, with no selector, id or click order. `checks` are read by the verifier from the page; the model never sees them. `phase: first` marks the four journeys the plan calibrates first.

tasks.task: Mark an area of the map for printing, add a second piece to it, remove one piece, clear the whole selection, then take the clear back.
Open the map from a link that carries a saved print area, reload the page, clear the area, then reload once more.
Find out whether this map shows traffic cameras, turn them on, go to one, open it, close it, and turn cameras off again.
Open a camera whose picture will not load and work out what you can do next.
Pick a lake on the map, find out what it is and where that information comes from, then close the details.
Show only the places that are open now, change the map to a different base picture, then switch to the 3D view and back.
Open each panel of the map in turn and get back to the plain map every time, using only the keyboard.
Save a place, reload the page, find the place again in your saved list, and share a link to it.
Get ready to print the area you selected, find out whether the print can be built, and stop before anything is downloaded.
Load the map with the network cut, see what the page tells you, then restore the network and get the map working again.
